### Events

| Name          | Payload | Description                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `run-started` | —       | Emitted when a new journey run starts; payload is the run id.                |
| `step`        | —       | Emitted when the journey moves to another step; payload is \{ from, to \}.   |
| `close`       | —       | Emitted when the dialog is dismissed. Answers already saved stay on the run. |
